newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Bacob bank buys broker Smeets, Verbaet.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Bacob bank buys broker Smeets, Verbaet.

text.p: Belgian cooperative bank Bacob said on Friday it had agreed to take a majority stake in Belgian brokerage Smeets, Verbaet.
"The aim of this acquisition is to reinforce our capacity with institutional clients and become more active in the share market," Bacob Chief Executive Dirk Bruneel told a news conference.
Smeets, Verbaet recently became more active in investment banking and will bring cancer treatment firm International Brachytherapy (IBt) to the Brussels' new small capitalisation market.
Bruneel said the agreement in principle had been singed. The due diligence procedure will start next week.
